B.finding: Official lower-bounds cost by the number of larger elements initially to the left of each element, then achieves the bound by moving values N,N-1,... right to final positions using Fenwick preprocessing. This is equivalent to frozen M0.

D.finding: Official converts the VPS to an ordered rooted tree, shows the operation is equivalent to arbitrary reordering of children, and counts modulo duplicate isomorphic subtrees using bottom-up labels in O(N log N). This directly corroborates frozen X1 and falsifies M0's coarser depth-profile assumption.

E.finding: Official compresses 0-runs into A packets of X plus residual 0s and 1-runs into B packets of Y plus residual 1s; reachability is characterized by residual 0/1 order and packet counts between residual symbols. Frozen per-particle residue signatures are an equivalent Ferrers row/column residue encoding.

postfreeze_e_equivalence_check.method: exhaustively mapped frozen signature key and official compressed-invariant key in both directions
